title: PEAK: 2014
subtitle: Italy, in millions; UN projection after 2023

lines.say: Italy's population peaked in 2014, at 60.7 million.
It has been falling ever since. Today, it's 59 million.
On the United Nations' central projection, the fall speeds up.
Very few births, about 1.2 children per woman, and a median age of 48. The full story is in our video.
